Artifact: Tab.app
Ticket: PER-414
Source commit: 57efc1950fa0f4dc1fe955cd36f4b8a2f20f3ad9

From the repository root:

  xcodebuild -project Tab/Tab.xcodeproj -scheme Tab \
    -configuration Debug CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO \
    -destination 'platform=macOS' test

  Tab/scripts/build-app.sh

The build script uses an ad-hoc signature by default and writes Tab.app beside
this file. To use an installed signing identity, set TAB_CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY to
its label before running the script. No protected permission is requested by
this milestone.
